_about: House Modern style for AI concept photos. Edit these to change how every new Modern version looks. Each photo uses the prompt for its room.
prefix: Return the edited image in the same aspect ratio as the original photo. Remove any people and any photos of people.

prompts.living: Renovate and virtually stage this photo as a bright, move-in-ready modern home, like a professionally staged Bay Area real estate listing. Keep the exact same camera angle, framing and room shape, and keep every wall, window, door, doorway, closet and ceiling in exactly the same position and size. Do not add, remove or move any window or door. Finishes: bright white walls and ceiling, white baseboards and trim, light natural oak wide-plank floors, recessed ceiling lights. Accents: matte black faucets, handles, light fixtures and picture frames. Remove all clutter, personal items and old furniture. Bright natural daylight, crisp realistic professional real estate photo. Stage it as a living room with a cream linen sofa, white accent chairs, a glass or light wood coffee table, a neutral jute rug, abstract art in soft neutral and green tones, a ceramic table lamp and a few green plants. If there is a fireplace, make it white with a charcoal surround.
